name: The Ritz Carlton Philadelphia
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton, Philadelphia, a hotel in a former bank building in Center City, across from City Hall
best_for: Travelers who want a Center City base across from City Hall
Guests who like a historic building and a Club Lounge
Families interested in the Ritz Kids program

facts.text: The hotel building was originally built as the home of The Girard Trust Company between 1904 and 1908.
The former bank building has a neoclassical style, a rotunda and an eight-story tower.
The hotel is in Center City, directly across from City Hall.
Aqimero, a Latin American restaurant by chef Richard Sandoval, is located in the hotel lobby.
Guests who book Club accommodations have access to The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge on the 30th floor.
The hotel has the Richel D'Ambra Spa + Salon on property.
The spa draws on Balinese traditions and offers rituals such as chakra balancing and reiki.
The hotel's fitness center is on the third floor.
The hotel runs Ritz Kids, a program for children with hands-on activities about the history and culture of the city.
The Ritz-Carlton Suite has a private elevator.

considerations.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking, and Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary access to the Club.
The hotel offers off-site valet parking.
The hotel does not provide shuttle service.
